with fuente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."raw"."departments"
)
select
    department_id    as departamento_id,
    department_name  as nombre
from fuente

with fuente as (
    select * from read_parquet('/workspace/lago/devoluciones.parquet')
)
select
    devolucion_id,
    linea_id,
    pedido_id,
    producto_id,
    cast(fecha_devolucion as date) as fecha,
    unidades_devueltas             as unidades,
    importe_devuelto               as importe,
    motivo,
    canal
from fuente

with fuente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."raw"."categories"
)
select
    category_id             as categoria_id,
    category_department_id  as departamento_id,
    category_name           as nombre
from fuente

with fuente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."raw"."customers"
)
select
    customer_id     as cliente_id,
    customer_fname  as nombre,
    customer_lname  as apellido,
    customer_email  as email,
    customer_city   as ciudad,
    customer_state  as provincia
from fuente

with fuente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."raw"."products"
)
select
    product_id           as producto_id,
    product_category_id  as categoria_id,
    product_name         as nombre,
    product_price        as precio
from fuente

with clientes as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_customers"
),
base as (
    select
        row_number() over (order by cliente_id)   as cliente_sk,
        cliente_id,
        nombre || ' ' || apellido                 as nombre,
        ciudad,
        provincia
    from clientes
)
select * from base
union all
select -1, -1, '(desconocido)', '(desconocido)', '(desconocido)'   -- miembro desconocido

with fuente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."raw"."order_items"
)
select
    order_item_id             as linea_id,
    order_item_order_id       as pedido_id,
    order_item_product_id     as producto_id,
    order_item_quantity       as cantidad,
    order_item_subtotal       as subtotal,
    order_item_product_price  as precio_unitario
from fuente

with fuente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."raw"."orders"
)
select
    order_id                   as pedido_id,
    cast(order_date as date)   as fecha,      -- dlt cargó la fecha como texto
    order_customer_id          as cliente_id,
    order_status               as estado
from fuente

with productos as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_products"
),
categorias as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_categories"
),
departamentos as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_departments"
),
base as (
    select
        row_number() over (order by p.producto_id)   as producto_sk,
        p.producto_id,
        p.nombre                                      as nombre,
        coalesce(c.nombre, '(sin asignar)')           as categoria,
        coalesce(d.nombre, '(sin asignar)')           as departamento,
        p.precio                                      as precio_catalogo
    from productos p
    left join categorias c    on p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id
    left join departamentos d on c.departamento_id = d.departamento_id
)
select * from base
union all
select -1, -1, '(desconocido)', '(desconocido)', '(desconocido)', 0   -- miembro desconocido

with fechas as (
    select fecha from "retail_el"."main"."stg_orders"
    union all
    select fecha from "retail_el"."main"."stg_devoluciones"
),
limites as (
    select min(fecha) as desde, max(fecha) as hasta from fechas
),
dias as (
    select unnest(range(
        (select desde from limites),
        (select hasta from limites) + interval 1 day,
        interval 1 day
    ))::date as fecha_id
)
select
    fecha_id,
    year(fecha_id)     as anio,
    quarter(fecha_id)  as trimestre,
    month(fecha_id)    as mes,
    ['enero','febrero','marzo','abril','mayo','junio','julio',
        'agosto','septiembre','octubre','noviembre','diciembre'][month(fecha_id)] as mes_nombre,
    isodow(fecha_id)   as dia_semana,
    ['lunes','martes','miércoles','jueves','viernes','sábado',
        'domingo'][isodow(fecha_id)] as dia_nombre,
    isodow(fecha_id) >= 6 as es_finde
from dias

with lineas as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_order_items"
),
pedidos as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_orders"
),
producto as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."dim_producto"
),
cliente as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."dim_cliente"
)
select
    l.linea_id,
    p.pedido_id                      as pedido_id,       -- dimensión degenerada
    coalesce(dc.cliente_sk,  -1)     as cliente_sk,
    coalesce(dp.producto_sk, -1)     as producto_sk,
    p.fecha                          as fecha_id,
    p.estado,
    l.cantidad,                                          -- aditiva
    l.subtotal                       as importe,         -- aditiva
    l.precio_unitario                                    -- NO aditiva
from lineas l
join pedidos p on l.pedido_id = p.pedido_id
left join producto dp on dp.producto_id = l.producto_id
left join cliente  dc on dc.cliente_id  = p.cliente_id

with devoluciones as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."stg_devoluciones"
),
producto as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."dim_producto"
)
select
    d.devolucion_id,
    d.linea_id,
    d.pedido_id,                                      -- dimensión degenerada
    coalesce(dp.producto_sk, -1)   as producto_sk,    -- dimensión conformada
    d.fecha                        as fecha_id,       -- dimensión conformada
    d.unidades,
    d.importe,
    d.motivo,
    d.canal
from devoluciones d
left join producto dp on dp.producto_id = d.producto_id

select pedido_id
from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
where pedido_id is null

select linea_id
from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
where linea_id is null

-- Grano: una línea de pedido entregada.
-- Resuelve una sola vez el join con dim_producto y la regla de negocio
-- "sólo pedidos entregados", que necesitan los dos marts de departamento.
with ventas as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
),
producto as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."dim_producto"
)
select
    v.linea_id,
    v.pedido_id,
    v.producto_sk,
    dp.departamento,
    dp.categoria,
    v.fecha_id,
    v.cantidad,
    v.importe
from ventas v
join producto dp on dp.producto_sk = v.producto_sk
where v.estado in ('COMPLETE', 'CLOSED')

with all_values as (

    select
        estado as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
    group by estado

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'CANCELED','CLOSED','COMPLETE','ON_HOLD','PAYMENT_REVIEW','PENDING','PENDING_PAYMENT','PROCESSING','SUSPECTED_FRAUD'
)

select producto_sk
from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
where producto_sk is null

select
    linea_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
where linea_id is not null
group by linea_id
having count(*) > 1

with child as (
    select producto_sk as from_field
    from "retail_el"."main"."fact_ventas"
    where producto_sk is not null
),

parent as (
    select producto_sk as to_field
    from "retail_el"."main"."dim_producto"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select fecha_id
from "retail_el"."main"."fact_devoluciones"
where fecha_id is null

with ventas as (
    select * from "retail_el"."main"."int_ventas_enriquecidas"
)
select
    departamento,
    count(distinct pedido_id)   as pedidos,
    sum(cantidad)               as unidades,
    round(sum(importe), 2)      as ingresos
from ventas
group by departamento
order by ingresos desc

with v as (
    select departamento,
           sum(cantidad)            as unidades_vendidas,
           round(sum(importe), 2)   as ingresos
    from "retail_el"."main"."int_ventas_enriquecidas"
    group by departamento
),
d as (
    select dp.departamento,
           sum(fd.unidades)            as unidades_devueltas,
           round(sum(fd.importe), 2)   as importe_devuelto
    from "retail_el"."main"."fact_devoluciones" fd
    join "retail_el"."main"."dim_producto" dp on dp.producto_sk = fd.producto_sk
    group by dp.departamento
)
select
    v.departamento,
    v.unidades_vendidas,
    coalesce(d.unidades_devueltas, 0)   as unidades_devueltas,
    v.ingresos,
    coalesce(d.importe_devuelto, 0)     as importe_devuelto,
    round(100.0 * coalesce(d.unidades_devueltas, 0) / v.unidades_vendidas, 1) as tasa_devolucion_pct
from v
left join d on d.departamento = v.departamento
order by tasa_devolucion_pct desc

with child as (
    select fecha_id as from_field
    from "retail_el"."main"."fact_devoluciones"
    where fecha_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select fecha_id as to_field
    from "retail_el"."main"."dim_fecha"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null
